metadata.title: Frenocar – Friction Materials Manufacturing & Renovation
metadata.description: Family company Frenocar – manufacturing of brake and clutch materials, spare parts for agricultural and forestry equipment, CNC metalworking. On the market since 1996.

home.heroDescription: A family company on the Slovak market since 1996. Brake and clutch materials, spare parts manufacturing, CNC metalworking and the proprietary FrenoFulx electric motor.
home.frictionDescription: Manufacturing and renovation of brake pads, shoes, linings and clutch materials for serial and custom machinery.
home.sparePartsDescription: Manufacturing spare parts for agricultural, garden and forestry equipment. Compatible with Zetor, LKT, Tera, Agzat and more.
home.sparePartsImageAlt: Parts for agricultural and forestry equipment
home.metalDescription: CNC machining, plasma cutting, tool manufacturing and powder metallurgy.
home.frenofulxDescription: Axial flux electric motor designed and manufactured in-house. Compact, efficient, quality engineering.
home.aboutP1: The family company Frenocar has been operating on the Slovak market since 1996. It was established in response to the absence of a brake material producer in our country. We gradually expanded our activities to include CNC machining, tool manufacturing, powder metallurgy and the development of our own FrenoFulx electric motor.
home.aboutP2: Our goal is to offer quality products at competitive prices, follow customer needs and maintain good business relationships.

footer.about: A family company on the Slovak market since 1996. Manufacturing and renovation of friction materials, spare parts manufacturing, CNC metalworking.

trecieMaterialy.metaDescription: Manufacturing and renovation of brake pads, shoes, linings and clutch materials. Serial production and custom orders for industrial machines and ships.
trecieMaterialy.heroDescription: We offer a wide range of brake and clutch materials. We use organic, Kevlar and metal-ceramic friction materials for the highest loads. From standard serial parts to one-off orders.
trecieMaterialy.renovationDescription: Renovation and production of all types of friction materials for cars, vintage vehicles, work and industrial machines.
trecieMaterialy.renovationItem1: Manufacturing and renovation of all types of brake linings
trecieMaterialy.renovationItem2: Manufacturing and renovation of brake pads
trecieMaterialy.renovationItem3: Manufacturing and renovation of clutch plates for dry and wet use
trecieMaterialy.renovationItem4: Renovation of pressure clutch discs and flywheels
trecieMaterialy.renovationItem5: Renovation of parts for agricultural and forestry equipment
trecieMaterialy.productionDescription: Manufacturing of brake and clutch components according to customer documentation or from an old part.
trecieMaterialy.productionItem1: Manufacturing of brake shoes from documentation or old parts
trecieMaterialy.productionItem2: Design of brake shoes and segments per customer requirements
trecieMaterialy.productionItem3: Turning of brake discs and drums
trecieMaterialy.productionItem4: Sale of brake and clutch semi-finished products
trecieMaterialy.atypicalP1: We can help you even when you can't find the part you need anywhere, its price is very high, or the delivery time is too long.
trecieMaterialy.atypicalP2: Whether you need a standard brake pad for a Zetor tractor, or a one-off clutch for a 40-year-old industrial press or a large ship — Frenocar can solve it.
trecieMaterialy.atypicalP3: In the past, we have also manufactured and renovated clutches for large seagoing vessels.
trecieMaterialy.ctaDescription: Contact us and take advantage of our 28 years of experience in manufacturing and renovation of brake and clutch components.

nahradneDiely.metaTitle: Spare Parts Manufacturing – Agricultural, Forestry & Garden Equipment
nahradneDiely.metaDescription: Manufacturing spare parts for agricultural, forestry and garden equipment — compatible with Zetor, LKT, Tera, Agzat and more. Wholesale deliveries for retailers.
nahradneDiely.heroDescription: One of Frenocar's main focuses is the manufacturing of spare parts for agricultural, garden and forestry equipment. We produce parts compatible with brands like Zetor, LKT, Tera and Agzat, as well as others. In addition to our existing range, we can produce custom parts to meet your needs.
nahradneDiely.agricultureDescription: Spare parts for tractors and agricultural machines — compatible with Zetor and other brands.
nahradneDiely.forestryDescription: Spare parts for forest tractors and logging machines — compatible with LKT and other brands.
nahradneDiely.gardenDescription: Spare parts for cultivators, rotavators and other garden machines — compatible with Tera, Agzat and others.
nahradneDiely.catalogP1: We are preparing an online catalog of all spare parts we currently produce. However, the catalog is not the limit — we can manufacture additional parts according to your needs.
nahradneDiely.catalogP2: If you are looking for a specific part, don't hesitate to contact us. We will be happy to advise you and prepare a quote.
nahradneDiely.ctaDescription: Contact us for wholesale terms. We supply spare parts for agricultural, forestry and garden equipment retailers across Slovakia.

frenofulx.metaDescription: FrenoFlux — axial flux electric motor designed and manufactured by Frenocar. Compact, efficient, quality engineering.
frenofulx.heroDescription: A compact and highly efficient electric motor designed and manufactured by Frenocar.
frenofulx.newGenTitle: A New Generation of Electric Motors
frenofulx.newGenP1: The motor is based on the axial flux concept, where the magnetic field passes between two stators and the rotor in the axial direction. This design allows for high torque in compact dimensions.
frenofulx.newGenP2: Thanks to the low rotor mass and small moment of inertia, the motor has excellent dynamic properties, which is particularly advantageous for vehicle propulsion.
frenofulx.motorDrawingAlt: Technical drawing of the FrenoFlux motor
frenofulx.advantageTorqueDescription: Thanks to its unique arrangement, the motor delivers outstanding power relative to its compact size.
frenofulx.advantageDynamicsDescription: Low rotor mass and small moment of inertia ensure lightning-fast response and excellent dynamic properties.
frenofulx.techParamsP1: The motor is primarily suited for small electric vehicles, but can also be used in various industrial applications.
frenofulx.techParamsP2: It can also be used as a generator.
frenofulx.techParamsP3: Its major advantage over other motors is excellent dynamic performance thanks to very low rotor mass and small moment of inertia.
frenofulx.developmentP1: The motor was developed with emphasis on manufacturing simplicity, reliability and construction quality. The entire development was initiated and carried out by me in our family company focused on small-batch mechanical production.
frenofulx.developmentP2: The concept was designed so that the entire product could be manufactured locally without the need for complex cooperation with external suppliers.
frenofulx.developmentP3: The entire process, from the first sketch to the final prototype, took 3 years.
frenofulx.developmentImageAlt1: FrenoFlux motor manufacturing in the workshop

frenofulx.ctaDescription: A compact and highly efficient electric motor — contact us with your requirements.
